profiles.notes: The LSX-Dodgers build of FuzzyBASIC 1.2L with X1Pen tokenizer and X1-specific graphics, sound, joystick and character extensions. Platform behavior is documented from the LSX port itself.

The SLANG compiler (slangc) of the SLANG-compiler browser bundle at compilerRevision, in its x1 environment (LSX-Dodgers on the X1), with that revision's runtime and include files. Schema v2 indexes compiler vocabulary, runtime metadata symbols and bundled include APIs, with dedicated entries for supported application-facing contracts. It is reviewed whenever X1Pen imports another bundle.
The exact two-pass assembler bundled with X1Pen, including its accepted mnemonics, expressions, directives, namespaces, conditional assembly, macros and predefined address-map symbol behavior.

profiles.displayName: X1 hardware implemented by X millennium Web
profiles.notes: The I/O and memory profile implemented by X millennium Web, derived from Z80_In/Z80_Out dispatch and device handlers and cross-checked against X1 technical documentation. It excludes peripherals not routed by the current build.

What the hubasic2sl converter and x1native runtime bundled in X1Pen accept, written only from the SLANG-compiler sources and docs/HUBASIC.md at runtimeRevision and from X1Pen's own code; it is not taken from the HuBASIC manual. It is reviewed whenever X1Pen imports another hubasic2sl bundle.
